source_provenance.focused_state: Pre-commit worktree captured by exact file hashes; production, tool, build and test bytes match the final committed snapshot.
source_provenance.full_state: All tracked and untracked source membership and bytes were frozen during the 17-gate run and verified afterward.

implementation.behavior: Validate identical spellings once. Reject different unquoted spellings without parsing unless both can be numbered slots. Preserve the original parser and decoded comparison for all remaining cases.
invariants: Malformed spellings remain invalid, including self-comparison.
Quoted/escaped aliases and numeric slots retain their identities and namespace distinction.
No allocations, caches, temporary-name ordering changes, skipped legalizers, retry changes or workload-specific rules.
All generated object and ownership bytes remain equal on the retained six input/mode combinations.
implementation.tests: Ordered comparisons across eighteen spelling classes, malformed names and quoted temporary-name collisions with gaps.

measurement_method.inputs: Retained accepted Fibonacci and migrate_langref IR in ReleaseFast, ReleaseSafe and ReleaseSmall; identical bytes for baseline/final.
measurement_method.primary: Two ReleaseSafe captures, five alternating timed runs per compiler/program.
measurement_method.secondary: ReleaseFast/ReleaseSmall captures, three alternating timed runs per compiler/program.
measurement_method.warmup: One per compiler/input before each repeated series; each timed sample is a fresh process.
measurement_method.initial_baselines: One warmup and three samples per Safe input before implementation; excluded from final repeated distributions.
measurement_method.host: AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS, Linux; desktop host not isolated; no project builds or tests overlapped measurements.
measurement_method.scope: Compiler throughput on retained IR; no generated-code speedup or cross-host claim. Short Fast/Small Fibonacci timing differences are unresolved.

validation.compiler_core_equivalence: All 36 canonical records match prior fresh execution.
validation.migration_observations: All 174 local/reference executions match independent expectations and both the focused and prior accepted observations.

c_input_program.mode_scope: Three local release pipelines; C assertions enabled and C sanitizers disabled.
c_input_program.oracle: Frozen expected observations, constructed from typed values and the upstream display format; error expectations from its explicit EOF handling. LLVM must satisfy these independently.
remaining_dependencies: Pinned Zig C frontend and LLVM IR construction
Clang 22 independent optimization and code generation
System linker, CRT and libc allocation/stdio

ownership_replay.source: Independent selection after object emission, compared byte for byte.

compiler_build_scope: The integration hook and explicitly selected whole-program routes use ReleaseFast. Ordinary/native builds and legacy hello-libc/upstream-C routes use installed Debug. Core runners are separately built from the frozen source.

retention.sampling: Full-run disk fields are gate-boundary samples, not a continuous minimum.

remaining_work: Selection itself still dominates the Safe profiles; temporary-name scans and ordered legalizer retries remain.
Independent ownership replay duplicates selection work and remains a regression check.
Broader callable compiler-core execution is subsequent coverage work; the accepted cohort remains nine functions per mode.
Pair/vector PHIs, spill destinations and ordinary CLI structural selection retain existing paths.
LLVM IR construction, the pinned Zig linker/compiler-rt and libc/CRT remain dependencies.
